chapters: Jano' ba' oidha' tas gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ xijumai maa'n gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu aggeo gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Judaa gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bham.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tɨbiap guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu aggeo bham.

Jano' ba' na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu vaak oidha' jix gaki.
Na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ xoi'kam bhaan gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix jai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dhi'ñi guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu u'u guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios aagak guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam nɨidhat tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gaagim jix jai' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu vaak guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; na gu' gu vaak oidha' jix gaki maa'n guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vaak.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tɨkɨr bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhuuk gu oidha' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu i'bhɨ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan dhi' gu oidha' bhaan gu kakkavɨk bhaan tiriik bhaan suudai' u'va bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu' bhaan bɨx gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan gu chichio'ñ bhaan gu vaakax bhaan bɨx tu jiim gu noobh.

Jano' ba' jix kai gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu aggeo na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu aggeo guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Judaa gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ bɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs tu' jix duu tu duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maakobh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ xijumai gook oidha' tas gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨv guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu aggeo bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jano' gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Judaa gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ja'tkam bham.

Jano' ba' chɨkka tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't buupui dhi' gu vaak guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gɇ'kamtu'nda' jano' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa cham na ja'p cham tu' vupui bhaan gu vupui.

Na gu' jano' gu Sorobabeel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gio gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ja'tkam bɨx gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.

Jano' ba' bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Ejipto gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'.

Na gu' na gu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨbɨɨp ɨlhdham gu Deseado guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' gu vaak gɇ'kamtu'nda' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Miia jix toja jodai guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix uam jodai tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.

Jano' ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ka't jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhai'x i'ii'ñ dhi' pai' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.

Jano' ba' maakob guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gook oidha' tas gu Dariio ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu aggeo bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' tu ñi'ook jano' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ñi'ook na tu a'ga bham.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kuichdha' gu takarui' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jugi ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gui'p; gio ba' cham.

Ba' jix aa' gu aggeo; gio ba' tu' ñaanbi' kuiñcha gu chuukug jix koi kuichdha' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gui'p; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't.

Ba' jix aa' gu aggeo; gio ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam dhi' gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx tu duukam gu noobh; jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ dɨr dhi' gu tanoolh guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn va'k jaisaidhat gu jodai bhaan gu jodai vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' va'k bhaai'n dhi' tu'x aajidha' gɨ' kavɨk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't mambhɨɨx; gio ba' aajidha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mambhɨɨx tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx gu jɨvɨl guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx tu duukam gu noobh; gu' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jano' gu i'ii'ñ dɨr dhi' gu tanoolh guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dɨr gu tanoolh maakob guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ dɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham gu kai' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' iigɨx tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' gu u'u guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gu' dɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' ka't gookim tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu aggeo maakob guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Sorobabeel guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Judaa bham; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' bhaan atooxkor guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu kavɨk oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' bhaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr aajim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gɨ' kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu kuchii xibhɨk.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel tu duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
